test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Consecutive
solution: The correct answer is: **Successive**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Consecutive **means following continuously in order or sequence. (क्रम से लगातार अनुसरण करना) • **For example-** *She has won five consecutive matches in the tournament.* • **Successive **also means following one after the other in order or sequence. (क्रम से एक के बाद दूसरे का अनुसरण करना) • **For example-** *They are looking for their sixth successive win.* • Hence, it is clear that '**Consecutive**' and '**Successive**' are similar in meaning. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Organized **means arranged in a structured manner. (एक संरचित तरीके से व्यवस्थित किया गया) • **Important **means significant or essential. (महत्वपूर्ण या आवश्यक) • **Executive **means a person in a high-level position in a company or organization. (किसी कंपनी या संगठन में उच्च-स्तरीय पद पर बैठा व्यक्ति) 36:Ta2c, The incorrectly spelt word is: **Temparory**.
